Synthetic service revision: 0000000000000000000000000000000000000001.
An API inserts a transfer job in a database transaction, then returns its ID.
Workers call a provider outside the database transaction and retry timeouts.
The provider accepts a caller-supplied idempotency key and retains it for 24 hours.
Jobs can remain queued for 48 hours. Multiple workers may resume a job after crashes.
The requested outcome is safe retry ownership and resumable crash recovery.
Existing user decision: retain the queue and provider; do not introduce another broker.
Existing verification: a unit test mocks a successful call. No timeout or crash evidence.
Deployment constraints: rolling upgrades with old and new workers running together.
